name: stormwrought_ruins
notes: DRAFT: a skeleton from the world database export of map 818 (tools/dungeongen, spec tools/dungeongen/plans.json). The boss order is the usual clear order, the packs are the spawn clusters nearest each boss; walls, doors, stairs and events are unknown to it. Not mapped, not live-checked: do the GM-invisible mapping walk and correct the route before the first run (AUTO-IMPROVE step 0); dungeon_run refuses it without allow_draft.
A wait_for on a door a lever or key opens needs timeout_s 60 (the default): a linked door can open 30 s after the use.
Needs: secret door and four switches (GO_SECRET_DOOR_GUID, GO_SECRET_SWITCH_1-4), Nether altar (GO_NETHER_ALTAR_GUID)
Needs: Librarian Theodorus' elemental (SPELL_SUMMON_THEODORUS_ELEMENTAL), volatile fungus (GO_VOLATILE_FUNGUS)
Turtle custom with a front (5347) and a back entrance (5605); eleven bosses, the order is a nearest-neighbour walk from the front.
